Description: The financial core: hundreds of glass and steel towers, skybridges, and streets that never empty.
Tree-lined streets of brick walk-ups and single-family houses, with school runs and weekend markets.
Flagship boutiques, marble lobbies and a boulevard built to be seen on.
Container stacks, gantry cranes, cold-storage warehouses and the smell of diesel and salt.
Two terminals, four runways, a cargo apron that never sleeps and a perimeter road built for speed.
The ring road, the tunnel under the Ashfall, and the bridges out to the basin.
Farmland, pine forest, the river's wide bend and three lakes that freeze in winter.
Switchbacks, a decommissioned quarry, radio masts and snow above 900 metres.
Strip clubs, noodle bars, garages, a precinct house and a hospital, all under one neon canopy.
The river itself, its mudflats, two marinas and the bridge the whole city argues about.
